name: Sanco Trans Limited
about: Sanco Trans Limited provides logistics services across multimodal transport operators and container freight station operations in India. The company offers port and terminal operations; container freight stations; warehousing and distribution solutions; freight forwarding, including air and sea freight; and transport and heavy equipment. It also provides custom broker for air and sea, delivery, and agency services, as well as container maintenance and repair, and stevedoring and break bulk services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
